overview: Revised after the implementation stage rejected the Redis design: all reliability mechanisms are in-process and use only framework packages. ASP.NET Core's built-in fixed-window rate limiter guards link creation; a readiness probe checks SQLite connectivity; a small middleware propagates correlation ids; UseExceptionHandler/UseStatusCodePages give uniform problem details; the existing click writer's drain/retry behaviour is documented and tested.

components.name: Program.cs
components.responsibility: AddRateLimiter (fixed window, policy 'create-link', PermitLimit from RateLimiting:CreatePerMinute), AddProblemDetails, UseExceptionHandler, UseStatusCodePages, CorrelationIdMiddleware, UseRateLimiter.

components.name: Endpoints/RateLimitPolicies
components.responsibility: Policy name constant shared by registration and endpoint.

components.name: Infrastructure/CorrelationIdMiddleware
components.responsibility: Echo incoming X-Correlation-Id (<=128 chars) or use TraceIdentifier; set on response start.

components.name: Analytics/ClickRecorder (existing)
components.responsibility: Graceful drain on stop; 3-attempt backoff on SQLite lock - unchanged.

decisions.decision: Use the built-in ASP.NET Core fixed-window rate limiter, in-process, scoped to link creation.
alternatives: Redis-backed distributed limiter (rejected: violates the 'no new infrastructure' constraint and the dependency allow-list)
decisions.rationale: Clarification Q2 forbids new infrastructure; the clarified scope is single-instance. The framework limiter needs no package and is configurable. A per-instance limit is explicitly documented as a limitation.
decisions.tradeoffs: Limits are per instance; scaling out requires revisiting. Fixed window allows short bursts at window edges, acceptable for abuse protection.

alternatives: Single /health that also checks the database
decisions.rationale: A database outage should pull the instance out of rotation (readiness) without restarting it (liveness).
decisions.tradeoffs: Two endpoints to document and monitor.

decisions.decision: Correlation id via a tiny custom middleware instead of a package.
decisions.rationale: Twelve lines of code, no dependency, exact control over header name and length cap.

filePlan.purpose: Modify: limiter, problem details, exception handler, middleware order.
Modify: readiness route, RateLimitPolicies, RequireRateLimiting on create.
New: readiness, correlation, problem details, rate limit (own factory with limit 3).

testStrategy: Existing suites are the regression gate (the shared test factory raises the limit to 1000 so they are unaffected). A dedicated RateLimitTests class uses its own factory with CreatePerMinute=3 to observe 3x201 + 2x429 deterministically. ReliabilityTests cover readiness, correlation echo/generation and problem+json content type. Operational readiness is additionally verified by the orchestrator's deterministic operability checks.
securityConsiderations: Rate limiting reduces abuse of link creation (spam/phishing at scale).
Correlation id length is capped to prevent header-based log flooding.
Problem details never include stack traces.
